alejandra (People Ops): FYI the review cadence doc was updated tonight. main change: clear escalation steps for missed manager deadlines.

ben (People Ops): TL;DR: managers have a 48h grace period after deadline. if not submitted after 48h, we auto-escalate to director.

harry (Director Eng): What's the notification flow?

alejandra (People Ops): Step 1: manager reminder 48h before due (calendar-bot). Step 2: manager deadline passes -> automated Slack DM + email. Step 3: 24h after that (i.e., 48h late) we create an escalation email to director and cc people-ops.

sara (Manager - Product): Is there any temporary hold on calibration for late submissions?

ben (People Ops): If less than 10% of a cohort is late, we proceed. If 10%+ are late, we defer that cohort's calibration by one business day and notify all participants.

dennis (IC - ML): For managers who miss the deadline because they're on-call/incident, can we request leniency?

alejandra (People Ops): Yes. Use the "manager miss waiver" form: https://redwood.app/forms/waiver?id=WAIV-2026-01 and include reason + incident ticket if relevant. People Ops reviews within 24h.

harry (Director Eng): Make sure the waiver form auto-tags the director so I get notified.

ben (People Ops): done. it tags the manager's director when submitted. if it looks like abuse (multiple waivers from same manager in a cycle), we escalate to HR lead.

reminder-bot: Calendar event: Manager reviews due Apr 02 09:00 UTC. Reminder will send Apr 01 09:00 UTC.

sara (Manager - Product): One request: can the escalation email include the list of missing employees and submission timestamps? reduces back-and-forth.

alejandra (People Ops): Good call 94 we've added missing-employee list + last activity timestamp to the escalation body.

dennis (IC - ML): Will the late manager be able to edit forms after escalation?

ben (People Ops): Yes. Escalation doesn't lock forms. It flags them for review. Directors can request edits via People Ops.

harry (Director Eng): Thanks. Please add this summary to the manager handbook and ping the leads.

alejandra (People Ops): Will do 94 pushing update to handbook and sending a short note to leads now. Thanks everyone.
